_doc: Gig objectives (Objective.make): each kind names its rules module in src/tactical/objectives/ and carries its tuning. Gig templates (gigs.json) map to these kinds through Campaign.OBJECTIVES. A new kind is a new module plus an entry here; Encounter, the HUD and the view only talk to the Objective interface. Numbers are HOUSE-RULE unless cited.

assassinate.name: Assassination
assassinate._vip: The mark: a Night City civilian (NC2045 civilian blocks, data/rules/npcs.json) who fits the target faction's kind; a kind with none fields the faction's own Lieutenant (Mini Boss at security 2+).

rescue.name: Rescue
rescue._captive: The captive: one of Night City's civilians (any NC2045 civilian block, Recruit.civilian_blocks) under one of these names.

escort.name: Escort
escort._client: The client: one of Night City's civilians (any NC2045 civilian block of the district, Recruit.civilian_blocks), unarmed, under one of these names. The rendezvous is the map exit the crew walks farthest to from the deploy zone, at least min_walk squares. HOUSE-RULE weights: a guard whose id is a multiple of hunt_every hunts the client (hunt_mult on shots at them, and closes on them); every other guard weighs a shot at the client client_mult.

defend.name: Defence
defend._hold: HOUSE-RULE throughout (the book has no siege rules): the hold lasts hold_rounds rounds by security level, from the first wave's round (first_wave: a round to get in position); waves every wave_every rounds until the hold ends, wave k (from 0) bringing wave_base + k * wave_grow Mooks plus one per crew member past two, and from the second wave the level's officers. The job is lost when the attackers hold the room (outnumber the crew in it) at lost_rounds round ends running, or wreck the asset (steel machine, CPR core p.182). The zone: the most secure room with min_room squares to stand on, its squares within zone_radius of the asset (on its middle square). Waves come in at the two map entries or doors of the building nearest arrive_walk squares' walk from the room (at least arrive_min), in turn. Attackers: pull per square of walk toward the room; one in wreck_every (by id) shoots the asset instead of the crew when it is in sight within wreck_range_m; one with no shot worth rush_below runs (Move and a Run) for the room while it is more than a Move away.
